recipe.visualDefinition: A tight, high-contrast studio portrait of a man in a black cowboy hat, looking downward with a pensive expression. The composition uses a dark, textured background and sharp focus on facial details, paired with clean, wide-tracked serif typography at the bottom.
coreVisualRelationships: The brim of the black hat creates a strong diagonal shadow across the forehead.
The warm, saturated skin tones contrast against the deep black of the clothing and hat.
The text is anchored to the bottom edge, providing a stable base for the dynamic portrait angle.
coreInvariants: Black felt cowboy hat with a wide brim

compositionAndHierarchy.subjectPositionAndScale: Extreme close-up, head and shoulders, filling 85% of the frame, tilted at a 45-degree angle.
compositionAndHierarchy.visualAnchor: The subject's eyes and bridge of the nose, highlighted by a soft directional light source.
compositionAndHierarchy.movementAndEyePath: The eye follows the diagonal line of the hat brim down to the subject's face, then settles on the horizontal text at the bottom.
compositionAndHierarchy.negativeSpace: Minimal negative space, primarily located in the upper right and lower left corners behind the subject.

colorSystem.contrastColorRole: Warm Peach and Tan (skin tones, hair)
colorSystem.saturationAndValueRelationship: High value contrast between the bright highlights on the face and the absolute blacks of the attire.
paletteRestrictions: Limit palette to earth tones and monochrome blacks

typographyAndGraphicLanguage.pairingStrategy: High-contrast serif for the name paired with a widely spaced, smaller font for the title.
graphicDevices: Horizontal alignment along the bottom third

candidateDirections.reason: Matches the high-contrast serif look of the primary text.
Appropriate for the secondary text with its small serifs and wide stance.

twoStageComposition.backgroundInstruction: Generate a close-up studio portrait of a man with a mustache and blonde wavy hair wearing a black cowboy hat and a black turtleneck. He is looking down pensively. Use dramatic side lighting that leaves half the face in shadow. The background should be a dark, slightly textured gray-blue.
twoStageComposition.overlayInstruction: Add two lines of text in the bottom left. The top line should be a large, white, high-contrast serif font in all caps with wide tracking. The second line should be smaller, in a muted gold color, with extreme letter spacing (tracking) stretching across the width of the first line.

verificationChecks: Is the hat brim creating a clear diagonal line?
Is the text legible against the dark clothing?
Is the tracking on the second line significantly wider than the first?
Is the lighting dramatic and directional?

adjustableVariables: Intensity of the gold accent color
mustRedesign: Specific facial features of the artist
Exact wording of the original title

mustAchieve: Sharp focus on the eyes and skin texture

postGenerationChecks: Ensure the hat does not obscure the entire face.
Check that the text is perfectly horizontal.
Verify the color balance is warm rather than cool.
Confirm the composition feels 'heavy' at the bottom due to the text placement.
recipe.reuseFormula: Close-up Portrait + Diagonal Hat Shadow + Wide-Tracked Serif Typography = Classic Country Aesthetic
